learning: Mass 0.5 kg lowered the score (iteration 7), so mass stays at 0.8 kg. kp 3.0 is the only controller change that has moved the score so far.
notes: Widened the row to +/-0.04 m at 16 mm and kept the iteration-6 controller, scaling weights to x/0.02 (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2) so steering gain per metre matches earlier races.
rationale: Iteration 6 (kp 3.0, mass 0.8 kg, y = 0.07 m, 16 mm, +/-0.03 m) is the best-scoring platform at 36.31. Its gain came from the slalom, while the oval and s-bend still end off track after one line-loss event with max_error near 0.061 m. Iteration 7 (mass 0.5 kg) lowered the score to 35.64, so mass 0.8 kg is kept. The Builder's iteration 8 geometry widens the row to +/-0.04 m at 16 mm, with sensors at y = 0.07 m. I keep the controller gains of iteration 6 (kp 3.0, ki 0, kd 0.05, base_speed 1.6, last_direction) so the spread is the only change. To keep the steering gain per metre of lateral offset equal to the earlier x/0.02 scaling, the weights are x/0.02: -2.0, -1.0, 0, 1.0, 2.0. The end weights sit at the +/-2 limit. The signal is a reading-weighted average, so its size is set by the weights, and this scaling keeps the earlier steering strength. Expected result, not measured: if the wider row reaches the tape earlier, line_loss_events on the oval and s-bend should fall. If the metrics match iteration 6 to four decimals, geometry is exhausted for this controller and the next lever is kd or base_speed.
